You'll work at the intersection of efficient on-device AI and higher-level reasoning — making a vehicle that thinks for itself at the edge.","doing":["Design and train lightweight models for perception and decision tasks on USV edge hardware","Quantise, prune, and optimise models to fit tight power, memory, and latency budgets","Build a reasoning engine that fuses sensor and telemetry data from multiple nodes into reliable commands","Define the command and decision logic between the reasoning layer and vehicle control systems","Validate models and the reasoning stack in simulation, then during USV field trials","Work with robotics and hardware engineers to integrate the AI stack into deployed vehicles"],"looking":["3+ years building and shipping ML models, ideally to embedded or edge targets","Strong Python and PyTorch; hands-on with model compression and quantisation","Experience deploying real-time inference on edge hardware such as Jetson or NPU-class devices","Solid grasp of reasoning architectures, LLM-based agents, or multi-node decision systems"],"nice":["Marine, aerial, or ground autonomy domain exposure","Experience with distributed systems or sensor fusion","Familiarity with ROS2 or embedded C++"]},"postedAt":"2026-10-23T09:12:44.295Z"},{"id":"r_d8c21164-3345-486b-b521-2caf72e89e1e","title":"Embedded Engineer","team":"Electronics & Firmware","location":"To be confirmed","workMode":"on_site","jobType":"full_time","experience":"2_4","jobFamily":"Systems, Hardware & Advanced Engineering","subFamily":"Electronics Design & Engineering","tirEntity":"HEED","tirOverview":"HEED — full-stack electric hydrojet marine propulsion engineered from first principles for global markets.","jd":{"summary":"Design the hardware and firmware that make our indigenous marine propulsion systems smart, safe, and reliable — from custom PCBs to the software running on them.","about":"We are building indigenous marine propulsion systems, and the electronics inside them decide how well they perform and how safely they run. As part of a small, hands-on team, you'll work across the stack — designing and bringing up PCBs, writing firmware for microcontrollers, and building software on embedded Linux and RTOS platforms. You'll move designs from schematic to board to working firmware to field test, with your work directly shaping the product.","doing":["Design schematics and multi-layer PCB layouts, taking boards from prototype through bring-up and debugging","Write and maintain production-quality firmware in C/C++ for microcontrollers (ARM Cortex-M, ESP32, STM32 or similar)","Develop software on microprocessor platforms, including board bring-up, drivers, and application code on embedded Linux or an RTOS","Implement communication interfaces such as CAN, UART, SPI, I2C, and telemetry links","Debug hardware and firmware using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and JTAG/SWD tools","Write test procedures, document designs, and support field testing and validation"],"looking":["B.E./B.Tech in Electronics, Electrical, Embedded Systems, or a related field","Around 2 years of hands-on embedded experience in industry, startups, or serious project work","Solid PCB design experience with KiCad, Altium, or similar, including schematic capture and layout"],"nice":[]},"postedAt":"2026-10-23T08:11:30.522Z"},{"id":"r_5b38606b-54fa-4df2-8f9a-5f7355cef006","title":"Innovation Associate Project Manager","team":"Innovation Programs","location":"Bangalore","workMode":"hybrid","jobType":"full_time","experience":"2_4","jobFamily":"Program, Portfolio & R&D Operations","subFamily":"Innovation Program Management","jd":{"summary":"Be the execution backbone of our innovation programs — tracking, governance, program data, and stakeholder coordination.","about":"ARTPARK turns deep-tech research into technologies that reach real users across India, and structured innovation programs are how that happens. The Innovation Programs team provides the operational, PMO, and systems backbone for technology development initiatives, working across startups, researchers, and internal teams. The Innovation Programs team is the execution backbone: governance, data, coordination, and tools that keep projects delivering. You'll report to the Innovation Program Manager and work hands-on across technology teams, startups, researchers, and vendors.","doing":["Set up and onboard new innovation, research, and technology development projects from initiation","Track project plans, milestones, deliverables, risks, dependencies, budgets, and action items","Coordinate with innovators, startups, researchers, and mentors to collect progress updates and supporting evidence","Maintain program data and ecosystem databases; conduct research and analysis to generate actionable insights","Build systems, tools, and documentation that enable efficient, consistent program execution","Support technology and commercialization activities and resolve execution bottlenecks across teams"],"looking":["Hands-on experience in program or project coordination, PMO support, or innovation operations","Strong structured data collection, analysis, and reporting skills","Excellent documentation discipline and stakeholder communication","Proactive, execution-first style; comfort working across startups, research organizations, vendors, and internal functions"],"nice":[]},"postedAt":"2026-10-23T07:46:31.617Z"},{"id":"r_b9927eac-efc8-47bf-b73c-360e828c0c2f","title":"RF Systems Engineering Intern / Graduate Engineer","team":"RF Engineering & Antenna Systems","location":"Bangalore","workMode":"on_site","jobType":"contract","experience":"2_4","jobFamily":"Systems, Hardware & Advanced Engineering","subFamily":"Electronics Design & Engineering","tirEntity":"Foucault Private Limited","tirOverview":"Foucault — sovereign Positioning, Navigation & Timing from LEO: navigation that survives jamming.","jd":{"summary":"Design, simulate and test antennas and RF systems for next-generation satellite navigation, from simulation to field trials.","about":"Foucault Private Limited, a Bengaluru deep-tech startup working out of ARTPARK @ IISc, is building resilient positioning, navigation and timing (PNT) for India. This role contributes to the design, integration and testing of advanced RF systems for satellite navigation and next-generation positioning.","doing":["Design, simulate and evaluate antenna elements and multi-element antenna systems using HFSS, CST, FEKO or similar tools","Analyse radiation patterns, gain, polarisation and impedance characteristics","Integrate and characterise RF front-ends for satellite navigation receivers","Develop multi-channel signal acquisition and signal-processing algorithms","Evaluate system performance through simulations, laboratory measurements and field trials"],"looking":["Strong foundation in antenna theory, electromagnetic simulation, RF engineering and signal processing","Final-year student or recent graduate (2025–2027 batches); Ph.D. students eligible for the internship track","Comfort with hands-on lab work, hard RF problems and real hardware","Working knowledge of EM simulation tools such as HFSS, CST or FEKO"],"nice":["Exposure to GNSS, satellite navigation or resilient PNT concepts"]},"postedAt":"2026-10-23T03:56:00.406Z"},{"id":"r_6d10e59b-a7a9-4dbb-bc17-a3ed19bc3a98","title":"Mechanical Packaging Design Engineer","team":"Hardware and Power Electronics Engineering","location":"Bangalore","workMode":"on_site","jobType":"contract","experience":"3_6","jobFamily":"Systems, Hardware & Advanced Engineering","subFamily":"Mechanical Engineering","tirEntity":"Hardstone Electric","tirOverview":"Hardstone Electric — indigenous, low-cost high-voltage power supplies replacing expensive imported systems for industry.","jd":{"summary":"Lead PCB mechanical packaging, thermal management, and enclosure design for high-voltage power electronics systems.","about":"ARTPARK's Hardware and Power Electronics Engineering team turns raw electronics into ruggedized, field-ready products for Indian deep-tech deployments.
